Priya Rao: Quick postmortem follow-up from the billing incident (delayed usage + token double-count). Root cause appears to be a race in the metering writer + a retry dedupe gap. I'm listing concrete action items below — please ACK and own where indicated by EOD.
Kevin O'Neill: ACK. I'll own the dedupe fix. ETA end of week. Sharing a short plan in BILL-2219. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: I'll handle invoice re-issue and credits for impacted customers. Need the list of impacted invoice IDs + delta amounts to proceed.
AJ Patel: I can generate the impacted invoice list. Running a query now, will attach CSV to the ticket.
AJ Patel: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, sum(token_delta) as delta_tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-09' AND '2025-11-10'
AND model = 'gptx-8k'
GROUP BY invoice_id, customer_id
HAVING abs(sum(token_delta)) > 1000;
```
Will upload results to BILL-2219 shortly.
BillingBot: NOTE: 42 customers flagged in BILL-2219 for manual review/crediting. Suggested workflow: generate credit memos, queue for Maria. :white_check_mark:
Sasha Gomez: Can we add a short-term guard: ignore metering retries with timestamp delta > 30s for dedupe? Safer than changing core dedupe heuristics immediately.
Kevin O'Neill: Good point. I'll prototype adding a request_fingerprint TTL (30s) and add unit/integration tests. If tests pass, roll to canary.
Priya Rao: Owners & due dates (please confirm in thread):
- Kevin O'Neill — metering dedupe patch + tests — due 2025-11-08
- Maria Chen — invoice reissue & credit memos + customer comms — due 2025-11-10
- AJ Patel — impacted invoice list CSV + backfill script — due 2025-11-07
- Sasha Gomez — rollout plan & canary monitoring runbook — due 2025-11-09
Add PRs and links to BILL-2219 and mark tasks done when complete.
Nate Li: Noted a recurring pattern: retry storms shortly after deploys cause processing duplicates. Ops will add a deploy-hook to throttle metering writes for 5 minutes post-deploy. Tracked in ENGOPS-987.
Priya Rao: Sync scheduled tomorrow 10:00am PT. Agenda: confirm fix merged, run backfill on staging, run invoice dry-run and spot-check top-10 customers. :eyes:
Maria Chen: ACK. I'll draft a short email template for affected customers and attach sample credit memos for legal review.
Kevin O'Neill: Draft PR ready -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/456 ; includes TTL check + new dedupe test harness.
AJ Patel: CSV uploaded to ticket BILL-2219: /private/drive/BILL-2219/impacted_invoices_2423456789.csv
Sasha Gomez: Canary started on staging at 09:20 PT. 30-minute window looks stable so far. Posting logs to the ticket.
Priya Rao: Two quick followups:
1) Kevin/AJ, please coordinate on the canonical token aggregation logic — we don't want multiple backfills conflicting. Use a single job with leader-election (k8s lease) and idempotent writes.
2) Maria, once you run the invoice dry-run, please post a summary table (invoice_id, pre_delta, post_delta, credit_amount) back to the ticket.
Kevin O'Neill: Will implement leader-election guard in the backfill script. Plan: backfill runs in small batches (100 invoices) with checkpoints in S3.
AJ Patel: Backfill script skeleton:
```
# pseudo
for batch in invoice_batches:
  claim = try_acquire_lease(batch_id)
  if not claim: continue
  diffs = compute_token_diffs(batch)
  write_idempotent_adjustments(diffs)
```
I'll push to the repo and link it.
Priya Rao: Thanks all. Please update BILL-2219 checklist with timestamps and leave a comment when each item completes. If blockers appear, ping @Priya directly. Closing this thread for now — we will reconvene after the canary window. :white_check_mark:
